name: Discipline Of The Church
overview: Scripture teaches that church discipline is exercised with authority and care, aiming to maintain decency, order, and sound doctrine within the body of Christ. Paul’s instructions in 1 Corinthians 5 demonstrate that discipline involves decisive action against sin to protect the spiritual health of the church, while 2 Corinthians 2 emphasizes the necessity of restoration and forgiveness after punishment. This balance ensures that discipline serves both the correction of offenders and the edification of the church, carried out in a spirit of charity and love.
